Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few immediate questions so we can triage on our side: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm the scope (security + availability + confidentiality?) and the date of the last audit? We need the auditor name to validate.
- Pen test: summary is good; do you have a public CVE list or a remediation timeline for any critical findings?
- Data retention: what are defaults (logs, input/output, embeddings) and can retention be configured per-tenant? Our legal/regulatory team will want that spelled out.
- Encryption: confirm encryption at rest and in transit, and whether customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported.
- DPA/MSA: Procurement will need a DPA. Can Redwood sign our standard DPA or provide yours for review?

Procurement: procurement@finexa.com will be handling the contracting cadence — their timeline tends to be ~3 weeks once they have SOC2 + pen test + a SOW and final pricing. Samir, please confirm if that aligns with your target launch.

If you can send the SOC2 cover letter + pen test summary + sample logs, we’ll run an initial security review this week and schedule a follow-up security call.

Best,
Alice
Head of Security, Finexa
alice.monroe@finexa.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Finexa - Security evidence, stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps

Thanks Alice — answers inline below: 

> - SOC 2: can you confirm the scope (security + availability + confidentiality?) and the date of the last audit? We need the auditor name to validate.

Yes — our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (2025 calendar year) covers Security and Availability controls. Auditor: RedRock Audit Partners. We’ve attached the SOC2-report-2025-summary.pdf (redacted for public transmission); we can provide the full report under an NDA if needed.

> - Pen test: summary is good; do you have a public CVE list or a remediation timeline for any critical findings?

Pen-test-summary-2025.pdf is attached — no critical unremediated findings. All high/medium were remediated within 30 days; we keep a published CVE & patch timeline internally and can provide a redacted list on request.

> - Data retention: what are defaults (logs, input/output, embeddings) and can retention be configured per-tenant?

Default retention: API request/response payloads (14 days), application-level logs (90 days), embeddings (90 days). We offer configurable retention windows per-tenant down to 0 days for ephemeral use-cases or up to multi-year if required under contractual terms.

> - Encryption: confirm encryption at rest and in transit, and whether customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported.

Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest. Customer-managed KMS is supported via AWS KMS and GCP KMS integrations (HSM-backed keys available on request).

> - DPA/MSA: Procurement will need a DPA. Can Redwood sign our standard DPA or provide yours for review?

We can sign your DPA provided it’s within our standard liability tolerances; otherwise we can provide our DPA for review. LOOPING IN: Neha Kapoor (Legal / Compliance) to coordinate redlines.

Attachments included: SOC2-report-2025-summary.pdf, pen-test-summary-2025.pdf, access-log-sample.csv. Also linking our SOW template and pricing sheet for procurement: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/sow-template and https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567.

Proposed next steps:
 - Security call: Wed 2026-02-25 10:00 AM PT (please confirm)
 - Procurement call to review SOW/pricing: week of 2/29
